metadata.name: GTA VI-Inspired HUD + custom Lucia ped (GTA V Enhanced)
metadata.description:
GTA VI-Inspired HUD + custom Lucia ped for GTA V ENHANCED (the 2025 PC version, GTA5_Enhanced.exe). By FBICat. Fan-made and inspired by GTA VI. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two. Some HUD art is taken from Rockstar's official GTA VI media and belongs to Rockstar Games. No GTA VI game files are included.
Same mod as the Legacy package; the DLC packs are converted to the Enhanced (gen9) resource format with CodeWalker's gen9 writer (the same conversion as CodeWalker's Tools > Convert Assets).
INSTALL - two packages, both to your mods folder 1. This package (the files). 2. GTA-VI-Inspired-HUD-RegisterPatch.oiv: registers the HUD's DLC packs in dlclist.xml and raises the gameconfig.xml pools. ViMinimap.asi must end up next to GTA5_Enhanced.exe; the minimap needs it to draw in fullscreen.
What it installs: the HUD (scripts\GTA6Hud.dll, scripts\Hud\, GTA6Hud.ini), the 3D minimap (scripts\ViMinimap.dll, MiniMap.* data, ViMinimap.asi), and the packs vihudfonts, vihudanims, luciaped and luciaolf - all gen9. No music: put your own mp3/wav files in scripts\Hud\Music and scripts\Hud\Radio\CustomMusic.
Changes in 2.2 - Added ViMinimap.asi, so the minimap shows in fullscreen (it was missing from 2.1). - Lucia no longer crashes the game: the 1.3 register patch raises MetaDataStore (the pool her packs overflowed) plus TxdStore and DwdStore, and registers her packs. Switch: hold Left Alt / D-pad down, press E to her portrait. - Commercial music removed.
Requirements (not included) - Script Hook V for Enhanced and a Script Hook V .NET 3 build that supports Enhanced - A mods-folder loader for Enhanced (OpenIV.asi only works with Legacy)
NOT TESTED in GTA V Enhanced. If it does not work, send scripts\GTA6Hud.perf.log, scripts\GTA6Hud.error.log, scripts\MiniMap.log and ScriptHookVDotNet.log.
https://github.com/Geckomacabre/GTA-VI-Inspired-HUD
metadata.licence: Personal use. By FBICat. Contains art cut from Rockstar's official GTA VI media (property of Rockstar Games) and the Grand Figma Kit VI (CC BY 4.0). Minimap based on "GTA VI MiniMap (3D Buildings)" by moddims.
